# nRF54LM20-DK firmware v0.8.1

NCS v3.4.1 pin. The firmware behavior is unchanged; all eight images are
rebuilt on the new SDK.

## What changed

- **NCS v3.4.0 → v3.4.1.** `west.yml` now pins the v3.4.1 LTS patch, and every
  live NCS reference in the repository moves with it. v3.4.1 is a patch on the
  same v3.4 release branch, with no declared breaking changes.
- **All eight images rebuilt on v3.4.1.** The four VCOM and four native USB
  images use the same `a1_4` presets and file names as v0.8.0. The COBS wire
  format, the `mars-bluetooth-hci` API, the preset names, and the transport
  behavior are unchanged.
- **No application source change.** This release moves the build base; it does
  not change the ranging protocol or the firmware behavior.

## SDK fixes in v3.4.1

The v3.4.1 top-level release notes have no radio-stack section; these four
fixes are named in the MPSL and SoftDevice Controller library changelogs
underneath the SDK.

| Defect | Component | Fix |
|--------|-----------|-----|
| DRGN-29129 | MPSL (nRF54LM Series only) | `mpsl_init` could hang indefinitely when called after `mpsl_uninit` with HFCLK24M still active, which can happen when USB is active at init. |
| DRGN-29277 | MPSL (nRF54LM Series only) | Releasing HFCLK24M left the clock running, raising power consumption. |
| DRGN-29459 | SoftDevice Controller | A CS Reflector shifted the CS tone phase incorrectly when IPT was used with multiple antenna paths. |
| DRGN-29669 | SoftDevice Controller | The controller could assert when an ACL connection with active CS procedures disconnected during a scheduling conflict. |

**The USB-after-`bt_enable()` initialization order is retained.** DRGN-29129
makes the ordering unnecessary, not wrong; removing it is a behavior change
that deserves its own justification and validation. The NCSDK-38624 avoidance
(`CONFIG_CDC_ACM_SERIAL_INITIALIZE_AT_BOOT=n`, UDC enabled on VBUS attach)
also remains in place.

**Sleep-current work is unblocked, not included.** DRGN-29277 fixes the
SDK-side clock leak that blocked it; the follow-up power-management work is
not part of this release.

## Validation

- CI runs `scripts/check-ncs-version.sh` and builds every initiator and
  reflector preset — four VCOM and four USB images — in the v3.4.1 toolchain
  container.
- The bench smoke on the standard IPT interval-1 USB initiator against the TAG
  reflector is tracked in
  [#51](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-cs-nrf54lm/issues/51).
- The released-image gate on the downloaded archive is tracked in
  [#52](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-cs-nrf54lm/issues/52).

## Compatibility

- The eight image names are unchanged from v0.8.0; scripts that pin a file
  name need no update for this release.
- Reflash if your work depends on one of the four SDK fixes, or if you want the
  artifacts to match the manifest. v0.8.0 and v0.8.1 are otherwise
  behaviorally identical.
- The full transport, hardware, and constraint reference is in the
  [v0.8.0 release notes](https://github.com/Metirionic/mars-cs-nrf54lm/releases/tag/v0.8.0).

## Known issues and constraints

- **High-speed USB is bench-validated, not production-qualified.** The bench
  measured a working 480 Mbit/s link on the DK. The v0.8.0 notes carried an
  "experimental" description from earlier Nordic guidance; the NCS v3.4.1
  release notes, software-maturity page, and nRF54L USB driver Kconfig and
  source carry no experimental label, so this release does not restate it as a
  Nordic claim.
- **Full speed is parity-only.** The 12 Mbit/s fallback carries the same data
  and console but does not meet the transport-headroom criterion.
- **The console is best-effort.** Its 1 KiB TX ring and the bounded deferred
  log queue can delay or drop messages, especially before enumeration.
- **The USB identity uses development IDs.** VID `0x1915` and PIDs `0x0001` /
  `0x0002` are Nordic development values; a USB-IF VID/PID remains pre-product
  work.
